# South India Painters

> South India Painters provides professional residential, commercial, and industrial painting services with 27+ years of expertise. Serving Bangalore and across South India with 234+ skilled painters using Asian Paints.

## About the Business
- **Company Name**: South India Painters
- **Founded**: 1999 (27+ years of experience)
- **Specialization**: Residential painting, commercial painting, industrial painting, waterproofing, wall textures, wood finishes, and wallpaper installation.
- **Address**: No. 35, 1st Stage, 2nd Phase, Near Chandra Layout Bus Depot, Vijayanagar, Bangalore, Karnataka, India - 560040
- **Phone**: 080 23391256
- **WhatsApp**: +91 9740556799
- **Email**: care@southindiapainters.com
- **Website**: https://southindiapainters.com/
- **Working Hours**: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM (Sunday Closed)

## Service Areas
- Bangalore (Bengaluru), Karnataka
- Chennai, Tamil Nadu
- Hyderabad, Telangana
- Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
- Madurai, Tamil Nadu
- Mysuru, Karnataka

## Core Services
- [Interior Painting](https://southindiapainters.com/services/interior-painting): Professional interior house painting, colour consultations, smooth wall and ceiling finishes.
- [Exterior Painting](https://southindiapainters.com/services/exterior-painting): Weatherproof exterior wall coatings, facade painting, and durable outdoor finishes.
- [Commercial Painting](https://southindiapainters.com/services/commercial-painting): Painting solutions for offices, retail stores, tech parks, and commercial complexes.
- [Waterproofing Services](https://southindiapainters.com/services/waterproofing): Roof waterproofing, bathroom leakage solutions, damp wall treatments.
- [Wall Textures](https://southindiapainters.com/services/wall-textures): Designer texture painting, accent walls, metallic and stucco finishes.
- [Wood & Metal Finishes](https://southindiapainters.com/services/wood-finishes): PU polish, melamine coating, enamel painting, and wood refinishing.
- [Wallpaper Installation](https://southindiapainters.com/services/wallpaper): Premium wallpaper roll application and custom wall coverings.
